title: S.I. No. 8 of 2026 - Tourism Development (Simeon E-Imports,
text:
87
Tourism Development (Simeon E-Imports,
Taxi & Touring Limited) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2026, No. 8
[ 26th January, 2026 ]
In exercise of the power conferred under section 81(a), 83(1)and
86(1)(a) of the Tourism Development Act, No. 1 of 2024, the Minister
responsible for tourism makes this Order:
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Tourism Development (Simeon-E
Imports, Taxi and Touring Limited) Order, 2026.
Approved tourism investment
2. The replacement of two vehicles by Simeon-E Imports, Taxi
and Touring Limited is declared an approved tourism investment.
Declared benefits with regard to import duty and excise tax
3.—(1) Subject to subsections (2) and (3), the declared benefits
for the approved tourism investment with regard to import duty and
excise tax are —
(a) a one hundred per cent waiver of import duty on two
2020 Cadillac Escalades;
(b) a one hundred per cent waiver of excise tax on two 2020
Cadillac Escalades.
(2) The declared benefits under subsection (1) are applicable for a
period of one year commencing from the 1st day of November, 2025
and terminating on the 31st day of October, 2026.
(3) The declared benefits under subsection (1) are subject to the
conditions that —
(a) the two 2020 Cadillac Escalades —
(i) is used for tourism transportation,
(ii) is insured at market value;

88
Tourism Development (Simeon E-Imports,
Taxi & Touring Limited) Order
(b) the management of Simeon-E Imports, Taxi and Touring
Limited —
(i) submits to the Ministry of Tourism a report within
thirty days of procurement of the two 2020 Cadillac
Escalades,
(ii) retains the exemption of the import duty and excise tax,
if the two 2020 Cadillac Escalades are disposed of for
unforeseen circumstances, where the vehicle is
insured at the market value, and the duties exempted
have been refunded,
(iii) submits data to the Ministry of Tourism and the
Department of Statistics to assess the impact on the
tourism sector and for monitoring and compiling the
Tourism Satellite Account,
(iv) does not sell the two 2020 Cadillac Escalades to an
approved tourism operator in the tourism transportation
sector, except if the vehicle meets the specified
standard,
(v) pays the applicable duties if the two 2020 Cadillac
Escalades are —
(A) used vehicles and are sold within three years from
the date of clearance by the Customs and Excise
Department;
(B) sold or used for any other purpose without the
approval of the Ministry of Tourism and the
Department of Transport, and
(vi) complies with the —
(A) reporting requirements of the Ministry of Tourism
and the Department of Statistics;
(B) monitoring, licensing and certification requirements
of the Ministry of Tourism and any other
Government agency;

89
Tourism Development (Simeon E-Imports,
Taxi & Touring Limited) Order
C) licensing requirement of the Licensing Authority of
the Department of Transport, including the Saint
Lucia National Standard - SLNS74:2016 Ground
Tourism Transportation and Motor Vehicles and
Road Traffic Act, Cap. 8.01.
Made this 22nd day of January, 2026.
ERNEST HILAIRE,
Minister responsible for tourism.
SAINT LUCIA
